values.title: Accessibility for Everyone
values.description: We build for the 2 billion people around the world who need some level of support when accessing the web.

values.title: Real-User Testing
values.description: Our team includes native assistive technology users who test against real-world usage patterns, not just automated checklists.

values.title: WCAG 2.2 AA Standards
values.description: We test against WCAG 2.2 AA standards with manual testing as our primary approach, backed by IAAP-certified professionals.

values.title: Building for the Real User
values.description: We focus on building the web for real disabled users, maintaining relationships with accessibility attorneys and advocacy groups.

heading_2: Engineering Equity for the Digital World
paragraph_3: Perspective Tester is a digital accessibility consultancy helping organizations create inclusive digital experiences. We work to ensure your online presence fosters inclusivity while protecting you from legal liabilities.
paragraph_12: A multidisciplinary team focused on practical remediation, legal compliance, and inclusive product delivery.
paragraph_15: We believe accessibility is a fundamental right, not an afterthought.
heading_17: Meet the People Behind Perspective Tester
paragraph_18: IAAP-certified accessibility experts and senior-level programmers with proven experience in accessibility implementation.
heading_23: Ready to Make Your Digital Products Accessible?
paragraph_24: Whether you need a full managed service or a platform to track your own remediation, we have a solution for you.
